boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UNI spaces for collaboration, focused study, creative work, campus events, and gathering.

cards.title: Book a Rod Library Study Room
cards.subtitle: Rod Library · individual or small-group work
cards.notes: Reserve a room for one to six people when your project needs a table, monitor, whiteboard, and a defined place to work together.
cards.short_summary: Reservable small-group and individual study rooms in the center-of-campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library lists study rooms for one to six people as individual or small-group spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use the library’s room-reservation link; availability varies.

cards.title: Use the Learning Commons for Collaboration
cards.subtitle: Rod Library main floor · high-sound floor
cards.notes: Choose the main-floor Learning Commons for a conversation-friendly study session, then move to a quieter floor when you need less sound.
cards.short_summary: Rod Library’s main-floor collaborative study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library identifies its main floor as a High Sound floor intended to encourage collaboration in studying and learning.
cards.access_notes: The library’s floor sound designations guide where collaborative work fits.

cards.title: Make Something at the Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Rod Library · creative work space
cards.notes: Bring a class idea or a small creative project and check the library’s Makerspace information before you go for current tools and access details.
cards.short_summary: A named Rod Library space for hands-on creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library lists Makerspace among its popular spaces to unwind and depicts students building there.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current Makerspace guidance before planning a visit.

cards.title: Take a Reset in the Mindfulness Space
cards.subtitle: Rod Library · quiet reset space
cards.notes: Build in a short reset between classes or study blocks by locating the library’s Mindfulness Space and following any posted room guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named Rod Library space set apart from regular study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library lists a Mindfulness Space among its popular spaces to unwind.
cards.access_notes: Consult library information or signage for current use expectations.

cards.title: Study Models in the Anatomy Room
cards.subtitle: Rod Library main floor · LIB 280
cards.notes: If anatomy is on your schedule, use LIB 280’s SynDaver and muscle model as a focused supplement to course materials and lab study.
cards.short_summary: A Biology collaboration space with anatomy teaching models.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library says LIB 280 is an Anatomy Room collaboration with Biology that contains a SynDaver and muscle model.
cards.access_notes: Designed for students studying this subject area; confirm any current room-use guidance.

cards.title: Rehearse in the ScholarSpace Presentation Room
cards.subtitle: Rod Library · presentation and collaboration space
cards.notes: For a presentation-heavy group project, explore ScholarSpace’s capacity and technology details, then reserve it if the group size and schedule fit.
cards.short_summary: A library room designed for lectures, presentations, and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Rod Library describes the ScholarSpace Presentation Room as a 20–106-person lecture and collaboration space.
cards.access_notes: Use the library’s reservation information; capacity and availability apply.

cards.title: Meet at Campanile Plaza
cards.subtitle: Central campus · Campanile gathering space
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a clear central meeting point, or pause to see the restored Campanile and the Sesquicentennial Bell installed there.
cards.short_summary: A renovated gathering space at UNI’s landmark Campanile.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI calls Campanile Plaza a central gathering space and says the Sesquicentennial Bell is permanently installed there.
cards.source_title: Honoring a campus icon | Our Tomorrow
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; observe any event setup or temporary access notices.

cards.title: Plan Around the Maucker Union Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: Maucker Union · multipurpose room
cards.notes: Check the Maucker Union event schedule before gathering here, especially if your group needs the Coffeehouse’s larger presentation-style seating setup.
cards.short_summary: A named Maucker Union multipurpose space with seating for events.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI lists the Coffeehouse as a Maucker Union multipurpose room seating up to 200 lecture-style.
cards.source_title: View Space: Maucker Union | Student Involvement & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Event setup and availability are managed through Maucker Union Event Services.

cards.title: Gather in Hemisphere Lounge
cards.subtitle: Maucker Union · flexible event space
cards.notes: For a campus-group gathering, look at the Hemisphere Lounge through Event Services and confirm whether its flexible setup is available for your date.
cards.short_summary: A named flexible-setup lounge in Maucker Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI lists Hemisphere Lounge as a Maucker Union multipurpose room with flexible setup.
cards.source_title: View Space: Maucker Union | Student Involvement & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Check the Maucker Union event schedule and Event Services procedures before use.

cards.title: Find the Maucker Union Plaza Roof
cards.subtitle: Maucker Union · outdoor campus-ground location
cards.notes: Add the Maucker Union Plaza Roof to a daylight campus walk and check the campus-ground schedule first if you are planning a group meet-up.
cards.short_summary: A named rooftop plaza included in UNI’s campus-grounds event locations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI Event Services lists Maucker Union Plaza (Roof) among its campus grounds locations.
cards.source_title: View Space: Campus Grounds | Student Involvement & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access may be affected by weather, events, or university operations.
